clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's anxiety rose as she lay awake over money in March 1988, she and your father moved to distance over money talk by May 1988, your brother's grades fell by November 1989, and your mother's anxiety dropped once she returned to work by March 1990. The shifts in money worry and distance between your parents sit beside the grandfather's death and your brother's functioning fall, all within a year and a half.

clusters.name: Your mother Della's cancer diagnosis, 1993–1996
clusters.reason: Around your leaving home for college in September 1993 and your mother's breast cancer diagnosis in February 1995, within the following months: your migraines rose in March 1994, you moved toward calling your brother most nights by April 1994, your mother received her diagnosis in February 1995, you moved away from returning your brother's calls by June 1995, and you moved to distance from calling home by February 1996. Your own symptom and the shift toward your brother opened this period before your mother's diagnosis; the diagnosis sits in the middle of the family's moves, and your distance from your brother and your mother follows it.
